root_cause.failure: SearchDeadlineExceeded — refused: search deadline exceeded after 27.8 min (budget 27.7 min) at depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1 round 5 candidate 26/31 (196 evaluations done). The search stopped rather than continuing to the cost backstop.
root_cause.what_that_means: the frozen C1 treatment path's FIRST operator is depth.causal_kl_greedy_v1, which runs its own greedy layer search — 31 candidates per round over several rounds at the observed 7.05 evaluations/min. The rebuild consumed its whole 27.66 min allowance inside that one operator and was still at round 5 of an unfinished sequence, with the other three operators of the path not yet started.
root_cause.class: a PLANNING/PRICING boundary, not an engineering defect. Nothing crashed, no contract was violated and no artifact was corrupted: the deadline mechanism did exactly what it exists to do, and it stopped the work instead of running to the cost backstop. What was wrong is the number.
root_cause.why_the_search_did_not_hit_it: the beam's clock is separate and 23x larger (635.96 min), and DEPTH expansions inside it are individually budgeted. The rebuild instead re-runs the entire fixed path under one 27.66 min reserve.
root_cause.prior_measurement_that_should_have_price: this repository's own Phase-B measurements put a DEPTH expansion at roughly 32 min on an L40S and at about 71% of a search's cost. A 27.665 min reserve could not fund the DEPTH step alone, so the rebuild was unfundable as specified before the session started.
what_a_decision_would_have_to_choose_bet: price the rebuild reserve from the measured cost of the whole fixed path rather than from a figure that does not cover its first operator
or let the rebuild REUSE the search's already-materialized DEPTH work instead of re-deriving it, which is a caching-equivalence question and needs an identical-decision proof before it may be trusted
or drop the rebuild from the session and obtain B's state_eval number in a separate, correctly priced run
root_cause._not_an_autonomous_repair: each option changes a frozen runtime envelope, the pricing record, or the B-identity mechanism. All three are maintainer decisions, and none may be taken under the campaign decision's engineering-repair authority.
root_cause.quantitative_defect_record: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c2/analyses/c2_baseline_reserve_defect.json -- the independently derived discrepancy, classified RUNTIME/PRICING ENVELOPE DEFECT: the 27.665 min reserve against a measured 50.705 min bound for the complete path, a shortfall factor of 1.833. Added after the fact; nothing else in this closeout is changed.
